title: Grusch on JRE: CIA psi programs as a key to stored craft

tellings.quote: Remember what Grush said on uh JRE uh you know they they started talking about remote viewing stuff and and David Grush says well what if the CIA started looking into this as a sigh stuff as a possible solution to serve as a key to unlock some stuff we have sitting around in a warehouse.

plain: The idea is that the CIA may have looked into psychic abilities as a way to unlock recovered craft the US is said to have stored in a warehouse. An online UFO researcher who goes by UAPGerb recalls that David Grusch, a former Air Force intelligence officer who says the US holds non-human craft, raised this on Joe Rogan's podcast while talking about remote viewing, the claimed ability to see distant places with the mind. If true, it would mean the mind itself was treated as a possible key to working the technology.
